name: Chamthong (Kangshoi)
ingredients: Seasonal vegetables (such as beans, pumpkin, potatoes, carrots, and peas)
instructions: 1. Chop all seasonal vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a pot, add water and bring it to a boil.
3. Add the chopped vegetables, ginger, garlic, salt, and Ngari (fermented fish) to the boiling water.
4. Cook until the vegetables are tender but not mushy.
5. In a separate small pan, heat a little oil and sauté dry red chilies and chopped onions until golden.
6. Add this tempering (tadka) to the boiling vegetable stew.
7. Garnish generously with chopped spring onions and coriander leaves.
8. Serve hot as a soup or with steamed rice.
description: Kangshoi, also known as Chamthong, is a signature Manipuri stew that reflects the region's preference for simple, oil-free, and nutrient-rich cooking. It is a staple household dish, prized for its ability to highlight the freshness of seasonal produce, with Ngari providing a distinct, umami-rich depth characteristic of Meitei cuisine.
